name: repoql-codex
description: Queryable code intelligence — explore codebase structure without reading files.

interface.shortDescription: Pre-built structural index of the codebase
interface.longDescription: RepoQL gives agents a pre-built structural index of the entire codebase — every file, symbol, and relationship parsed, connected, and summarized. Explore 1000 files in 1500 tokens, query relationships with SQL, and read exactly the slice you need via URI addressing. Requires the `rql` CLI (https://downloads.repoql.ai).
defaultPrompt: Give me a one-screen orientation to this codebase
Show me the call graph around <function>
